name: command
help:
⚙️ Consent Command
Set a default or updated value for each consent type you are using. The consent state is guaranteed to be processed in this container before any queued data layer items are processed.

default
Set a default consent state for each consent type using the setDefaultConsentState API.

update
Set an updated consent state for each consent type using the updateConsentState API.

subParams.name: regions
subParams.help:
🌍 Regions
Provide a comma-separated list of country codes and/or subdivision codes according to ISO 3166-2.

subParams.name: includeEEA
subParams.help:
🌍 Include EEA Regions
Automatically include all regions from the European Economic Area in the list of regions.

🔗 Consent Mode - Advanced - Region-Specific Behavior
🔗 Consent Mode - Templates - Region-Specific Behavior

subParams.name: getStateFromVar
subParams.help:
⚙️ Read Settings From Variable
Provide an object with key-value pairs that represent the desired consent state (see example below).

A consent type will be set to granted if it has a value of:
🔹 "granted" (string)
🔹 "true" (string)
🔹  true (boolean)
🔹  1 (one)

A consent type will be set to denied if it has a value of:
🔹 "denied" (string)
🔹 "false" (string)
🔹  false (boolean)
🔹  0 (zero)

If a consent type has any other value than what is listed above it will be regarded as (not set) and excluded from the resulting consent command.

Example
If the input variable has the following value:
{
  analytics_storage:   "granted",
  ad_user_data:     "denied",
  ad_personalization:    "true",
  personalization_storage:  false,
  functionality_storage:    undefined,
  security_storage:     "INVALID"
}

The resulting consent state will be:
{
  analytics_storage:   "granted",
  ad_user_data:     "denied",
  ad_personalization:    "granted",
  personalization_storage: "denied",
}

subParams.name: analytics_storage
subParams.help:
⚙️ analytics_storage
Enables storage, such as cookies (web) or device identifiers (apps), related to analytics, for example, visit duration.

If denied:
🔹 Google tags will not read or write first-party analytics cookies or app identifiers.
🔹 Cookieless pings (web) or signals (apps) will be sent to Google Analytics for basic measurement and modeling purposes (advanced consent mode).
🔹 Google Analytics 4 will use cookieless pings for behavioral modeling (advanced consent mode).

🔗 Consent Mode Overview - Consent Types
🔗 Consent Mode Overview - Tag Behaviour
🔗 Analytics - Consent Mode Behavior

valueValidators.errorMessage: This value cannot be "(not set)" while consent integration with Microsoft Clarity is enabled.

subParams.name: ad_storage
subParams.help:
⚙️ ad_storage
Enables storage, such as cookies (web) or device identifiers (apps), related to advertising.

If denied:
🔹 No new cookies or device identifiers pertaining to advertising may be written.
🔹 No existing advertising cookies or device identifiers may be read.
🔹 Requests are sent through a different domain to avoid previously set third-party cookies from being sent in request headers.
🔹 Google Analytics will not read or write Google Ads cookies, and Google signals features will not accumulate data for this traffic.
🔹 Ads products truncate IP addresses at collection.
🔹 IP addresses are used to derive IP country and then immediately deleted upon collection.
🔹 Full page URL is collected, and may include ad-click information in URL parameters (e.g., GCLID / DCLID). Ad-click information will only be used to approximate accurate traffic measurement.

🔗 Consent Mode Overview - Consent Types
🔗 Consent Mode Overview - Tag Behaviour
🔗 Analytics - Consent Mode Behavior

subParams.name: ad_user_data
subParams.help:
⚙️ ad_user_data
Sets consent for sending user data to Google for online advertising purposes.

If denied:
Personal data collection for online advertising is disabled, including:
🔹 user_id
🔹 Hashed first party data (enhanced conversions)

subParams.help:

Sets consent for personalized advertising.

If denied:
The following features won't receive data:

🔹 Remarketing in Display & Video 360
🔹 Remarketing in Search Ads 360

subParams.name: waitForUpdate
wait_for_update
subParams.help:
⌛ Time to Wait
How long to wait (in milliseconds) for an update command before firing queued up Google tags.

⚙️ Wait For Update
Enabling this setting allows you to specify a millisecond value to control how long to delay queued up Google tags from sending data. This gives time for an update command to be registered.

🔗 Consent Mode - Integrate with Asynchronous CMP

subParams.name: url_passthrough
subParams.help:
⚙️ URL Passthrough
When ad_storage is denied, URL passthrough can be used to persist information about ad clicks from one page to the next by appending it to the URL as URL parameters.

Similarly, if analytics_storage is set to denied, URL passthrough can be used to persist event- and session-based analytics (including key events) across pages without the use of cookies.

The following conditions must be met in order to use URL passthrough:
✔️ Consent mode is implemented on the page.
✔️ Your Google tag is consent-aware and present on the page (advanced consent mode).
✔️ The outgoing link refers to the same domain as the current page's domain (internal page navigation).

When using URL passthrough, a few query parameters may be appended to links as users navigate through pages on your website:
🔹 gclid
🔹 dclid
🔹 gclsrc
🔹 _gl
🔹 wbraid

🔗 Consent Mode - URL Passthrough

subParams.name: ads_data_redaction
subParams.help:
⚙️ Ads Data Redaction
Enable this setting to further redact your ads data when consent for ad_storage is denied.

If enabled and ad_storage is denied:
🔹 Requests are sent through a different domain to avoid existing third-party cookies from being included in request headers.
🔹 Ad-click identifiers (e.g., gclid / dclid) in consent and key event pings are redacted.
🔹 Page URLs with ad-click identifiers are redacted.

🔗 Consent Mode Templates - Redact Ads Data

🔗 Analytics - Consent Mode Behavior

subParams.name: extMsClarity
subParams.help:
Microsoft Clarity
Enables consent mode integration with Microsoft Clarity through the consentv2 call, which is sent for granted and denied consent alike.

The integration reads from:
 analytics_storage
 ad_storage

Read more here:
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/clarity/setup-and-installation/consent-mode
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/clarity/setup-and-installation/clarity-consent-api-v2
